answer: Sure! Here's something interesting about octopuses: they have three hearts! Two of the hearts pump blood to the gill, and the third pumps it to the rest of the body. Even more fascinating, when octopuses swim, the heart that serves the body actually stops beating to conserve energy. This makes swimming more tiring for them, which is why they usually prefer crawling instead of swimming.
